title: Pip's Perfect Teapot
brief: Print Pip a proper teapot: round belly, a spout that pours, a loop handle and a lid with a knob. Pip asked for beige. Nova said no. When it's done, a tea bench appears outside the workshop.

lines: Teal! With a GOLD band! I'm crying.
Beige teapot? Over my dead easel.
The spout will not drip. I've decided.
I'll drink tea from it. Not admire it.
Teal filament, delivered by yours truly!
Write my name on the teapot, please.

nova: Pip asked for a 'nice sensible beige'. I had to lie down for ten minutes.
Teal belly, gold band, cherry lid. It's not a teapot, it's a lifestyle.
Still owe Pip those stripes. A teapot is basically a hug, though.
pip: Teapot. Spout. Handle. Lid. Four parts doing one job. Beautiful.
Nova added a gold band. It does nothing. I've chosen peace.
The stripes can wait. Tea cannot.
gull: Filament for a TEAPOT? I've carried treasure lighter than this. Probably.
Every cup Pip drinks is, technically, thanks to me.
A tea bench by the workshop! I'll moor nearby and accept compliments.
